mentions.h: SOUTHERN LEAGUE DIV. 6 BATTERSEA PARK, 29 JUN 1991
Down and out of the Premiership!

photos.c: No, you're not seeing things! It's Ken to Abi in the 4x1 - lane 2 at Battersea will never be the same again as about 8 hundredweight of throwing power dented the track in a semi serious, sorry make that deadly serious relay! The changeover at the bottom bend involved Mike Small and Vince Cornibert.
